raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions.txn_date is derived from ingest_ts (the batch load timestamp, which is always the day after the transaction) instead of txn_ts. All 4582 POSTED rows therefore fail the DATE_CONSISTENCY check, and the gold daily aggregates are bucketed by load date rather than transaction date. Deriving txn_date from CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) matches the monitor's invariant and keeps the same DATE column type; the gold steps recompute from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
